title: Renovation Budget vs Actual
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:budget
| stats sum(estimated) as estimated, sum(actual) as actual by phase
| eval variance=actual-estimated, variance_pct=round(100*(actual-estimated)/estimated,1)
| sort - variance
description: Compares estimated versus actual spend for each renovation phase so overruns are obvious as they happen.
value: Renovations almost always run over; phase-level variance lets you find and control the culprit early.
implementation: Ingest estimates and receipts into `index=personal`; compute variance per phase.
visualization: Bar chart of estimated versus actual spend by phase.
grandmaExplanation: It compares what each part of the job was meant to cost with what it really cost, so overspending shows up fast.
